name: Ankh: Gods of Egypt

categories.label: Devotion track level at game end
categories.labelVi: Mức Devotion trên track khi kết thúc
categories.hint: Read the Ankh token position on the Devotion track after the last Event resolves.

categories.label: Order in shared Devotion space (1 = top of stack)
categories.labelVi: Thứ tự trong ô Devotion chung (1 = trên cùng)
categories.hint: If Ankh tokens share a space, the token higher in the stack has more Devotion.

categories.label: Reached top of Devotion track (instant win)
categories.hint: Instant win the moment the Ankh token reaches the top space.

categories.label: Forgotten (eliminated after 4th Conflict)
categories.labelVi: Bị lãng quên (bị loại sau Conflict thứ 4)
categories.hint: Gods still in the red section after the 4th Conflict event are eliminated.

tiebreakers.description: Within a shared Devotion space, the Ankh token higher in the stack has more Devotion

winCondition: Win immediately by reaching the top of the Devotion track, or as the only god left after the 4th Conflict event; otherwise the god with the most Devotion after the last Event wins.

endCondition.description: Ends when a god reaches the top Devotion space, or only one god remains after the 4th Conflict, or after the last Event on the Events track.

notes: family: area-control-majority. Devotion is gained during play (monument majorities, battles, ankh/event effects); the scorer only records the final Devotion level. If all gods are forgotten, Egypt becomes atheistic and everyone loses. Merged gods share one Devotion token; handling of merged-pair victory not verified. Scenario-specific rules and expansions (Pantheon, Pharaoh, Guardians) not modelled. If a Devotion track value is not known, use the stack order only.

sources.title: Ankh: Gods of Egypt rulebook (English, via 1jour-1jeu)
